2004.notes: Employee occupational privilege tax of $5 per month on employees receiving $750 or more in the month for work in Glendale (city Occupational Privilege Tax Return and instructions, Wayback capture of January 10, 2004; employers match $5). The tax was enacted by Ord. 21, Series of 2003 (secs. 3.21.010 and 3.21.030: $5 per month, employee defined by at least $750 in the calendar month), adopted December 2, 2003 after the November 2003 vote; the city's January 2000 tax page said it had no occupation or head tax, so 2004 is the first full year (hence 'since').

2005.notes: Employee occupational privilege tax of $5 per month on employees receiving at least $750 in the calendar month: Ord. 21, Series of 2003, secs. 3.21.010 and 3.21.030 (Wayback copy from the city site), as in the 2004 return; Ord. 2005-5 amended both sections, and the current code (eCode360) still gives $5 and $750. Year-specific documents not located.
